name: orchestrator-test
feature: Exercise integration, rejection, dependency blocking, and independent scheduling paths.
acceptance_checks: A rejected task blocks only its dependents.
Independent tasks may still run and integrate.

tasks.task: The deterministic test runner supplies this artifact.
semantic_constraints: The fake runner must return a patch that can be integrated.

tasks.task: The deterministic test runner rejects this task.
semantic_constraints: The fake runner must reject this task deterministically.

tasks.description: Skip a task whose prerequisite was rejected.
tasks.task: This task must not reach the deterministic runner.
semantic_constraints: This task must not run when reject_b is rejected.

tasks.description: Integrate an independent task despite another branch being rejected.
tasks.task: The deterministic test runner supplies this artifact.
semantic_constraints: The independent task must remain runnable after reject_b fails.
